disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean, SD, range and CV of cadmium (mg/kg) in rice, wheat flour and other processed grain products for 20 Chinese provinces from the national food safety sampling system, 2023-2024.

study.design: Secondary analysis of national food safety sampling inspection data with risk indices and k-means++ risk classification
study.market: National Food Safety Sampling Inspection Information System samples (State Administration for Market Regulation)

unresolved: Analytical methods, detection limits and per-province sample counts are not reported (secondary use of official inspection data).
Non-detects set to 0 and "<" results kept at their numeric value bias the means.
Text says other processed grain products have a mean of 0.01369 mg/kg, but Table 1 gives 0.01369 for wheat flour and 0.01590 for other products; Table 1 is used.
Table 3 (high-risk city-product combinations) gives risk levels only, no concentrations.
The "Range" column is a spread (max minus min) and was kept in notes only.
